Manuals for the appliances etc, mostly PDFs.

  • boiler - The thermostat by the firedoor controls the central heating times and temperatures.
  • carbon monoxide alarm - FireAngel - Please test occasionally; push the button and cover your ears (or the speaker hole).
  • carbon monoxide alarm - Kidde - Please test occasionally (as above).
  • dishwasher - The AEG manual 7.2 says "Multi-tabs containing salt are not effective enough to soften hard water". The water is London is very hard (260 mg/L calcium carbonate), and AEG recommends for hard water using separate dishwasher detergent, rinse aid and salt (section 10.2); rather than 3-in-1 multi-tablets. In general tablets may not fully dissolve on short programs. For rinse-aid settings (inc deactivation) see section 7.3.
  • fire alarms - Ei141RC smoke and Ei146RC heat detectors - Please test occasionally (the manufacturer says weekly...); push the button and cover your ears.
  • fridge (Miele)
  • fridge (Hotpoint)
  • hob
  • oven - This oven has two self-cleaning functions, 'hydrolytic' and 'pyrolytic'.
  • tumble dryer - This dryer has a fluff filter in the door which needs to be gently brushed out regularly.
  • TV
  • vacuum cleaner - Dirt is collected in a bag inside, this needs to be replaced when full (or nearly full).
  • washing machine
